account_balance_adjustments_sign.name: account_balance_adjustments_sign
account_balance_adjustments_sign.value: ("account_balance_adjustments"."kind"='deposit' and "account_balance_adjustments"."amount">0) or ("account_balance_adjustments"."kind"='withdrawal' and "account_balance_adjustments"."amount"<0) or ("account_balance_adjustments"."kind"='other' and "account_balance_adjustments"."amount"<>0 and length(trim("account_balance_adjustments"."explanation"))>0)

review_attachments_limits.name: review_attachments_limits
review_attachments_limits.value: "review_attachments"."bytes">0 and "review_attachments"."bytes"<=10485760 and "review_attachments"."width" between 1 and 16000 and "review_attachments"."height" between 1 and 16000 and "review_attachments"."width"::bigint*"review_attachments"."height"<=40000000

trading_accounts_firm_required.name: trading_accounts_firm_required
trading_accounts_firm_required.value: "trading_accounts"."stage" = 'Personal' or ("trading_accounts"."firm" is not null and length(trim("trading_accounts"."firm")) > 0)

trading_accounts_opening_pair.name: trading_accounts_opening_pair
trading_accounts_opening_pair.value: ("trading_accounts"."opening_balance" is null and "trading_accounts"."opening_balance_date" is null) or ("trading_accounts"."opening_balance" is not null and "trading_accounts"."opening_balance_date" is not null)
